newsitem.title: UK: Inspiration to take big charge, shares slump.
newsitem.headline: Inspiration to take big charge, shares slump.

text.p: Tour operator Inspirations Plc said it will have substantial one-off costs in the current year due to delays caused by aircraft maintenance schedule problems in August and September.
It will break even in the year to September 30 1996 before any recovery of costs from the group's aviation engineering and maintenance supplier.
It plans to offer a final dividend of 2.72 pence a share, making a total for the year of 3.50 pence, unchanged from the previous year. Inspiration's shares were 37 pence lower at 97.5 by 0934 GMT.
"The board is disappointed that the engineering problems have marred an otherwise strong performance," the group said in a statement.
It said had taken steps to ensure that future maintenance problems would not affect the business.
